example.introduction: The installation has profiling disabled. The controller records the outcome on the capture.
example.nextCheck: Check the installation's profiling settings before submitting another capture.
example.title: Profiling disabled

narrative:
Read `status.phase`, `status.reason`, and `status.message` to track the capture. The capture has its own outcome, separate from the profiled workload.

| Phase or reason | What to check |
| --- | --- |
| `Armed`, `Capturing`, `Finalizing` | The controller has prepared the capture, is collecting data, or is processing the result. Check `status.identity` when present to confirm the target pod and container. |
| `Ready` | The capture completed. Use `status.artifact` for the stored profile. A successful CPU export also supplies `status.flamegraph`. |
| `Partial` | Inspect the reason before using the profile. For `NoSamplesInSelectedWindow`, choose a window when the target process is active. For `CollectorExitedBeforeWindow`, the CPU collector stopped early. Check `status.artifact` for a partial profile. |
| `Unsupported` | For `ProfilingDisabled`, check installation profiling settings. For a CPU capture with `NoRunningTarget`, check whether the target pod and container are running. With `AmbiguousTargetSelectPodAndContainer`, specify the pod and container to select one target. For `CudaCaptureToolingUnavailable`, check the training target and installed CUDA profiling tools. Use step-based triggers for `CaptureTriggerUnsupported`. For `CaptureMustBeArmedBeforeLaunch`, request CUDA capture before the initial training plan is frozen. |
| `Failed` | Inspect the reason. `CollectorJobDisappeared` means the collector Job was lost. For `CaptureExportFailed`, inspect the collector result and artifact storage access. |
| `Cancelled` | The controller stopped the capture. Check `status.cleanupComplete` for cleanup of the capture resources. |

For a CUDA capture, the controller can copy the reason from the worker receipt. Read the reason and inspect the target training attempt.

A terminal phase can appear before cleanup finishes. If the reason is `CaptureLaunchUnresolved`, the controller retains the cleanup finalizer until it can establish the outcome of the collector launch.
